description: This file defines locale-specific culture information for the 'az-Latn-AZ' culture in the DateJS library, including day names, month names, date formats, regex patterns for parsing dates, and methods for date manipulation tailored for the Azerbaijani Latin (AZ) culture.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets time components (hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds) of a Date instance to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time components of a Date instance to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Date instance.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current Date with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week based on the day's name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month based on its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines whether a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Retrieves the timezone name for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the timezone offset for a given timezone name.
